messages.subject: Setting prior item parameters
parts:
Hello all,

I am using the package mirt for my simulations. I wanted to find out
how I can set prior item parameters.

In the mod2values output, I see there are three columns "prior.type",
"prior_1" and "prior_2." Is it possible to specify the prior values
in this step, and if so, how would I go about this?

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,

Kondwani

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Setting prior item parameters
parts:
When you say 'prior item parameters' are you referring to applying Bayesian prior distributions, or starting values. If the latter, here's an example that changes the starting values of the model using the usual pars = 'values' chain. In this example, the model also converges instantly due to the TOL = NA argument. 

http://philchalmers.github.io/SimDesign/html/04-Auxillary_parameter_recovery.html  

Phil
